caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP row 170453 reports PUW/MIN 4a HeLa IC50=20 uM, but the primary article says the semi-synthetic 4a/4b IC50 values could not be calculated.
The local source supports qualitative weak/diminished cytotoxicity for 5a-5d rather than exact IC50 values.
